positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed multiple marketing and e-commerce websites using a headless architecture (GatsbyJS & Shopify/Wordpress) to create a more performant & customizable product.
- Integrated third party services such as Recharge subscriptions (e-commerce site) resulting in a 20% increase in recurring sales.
- Coded many components of varying complexity using React, several of which have been re-used by the team across other projects to improve the velocity of development.
- Implemented tooling such as eslint and stylelint in order to ensure code consistency, quality and maintainability.
- Conducted code reviews via Github, tested pull requests, and provided feedback as needed.
- Collaborated with design and project managers using tools such as JIRA, Figma and Slack while using agile methodologies in order to plan and execute projects.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
- Custom coded modular websites leveraging Shopify, Magento and Wordpress; enabling administrators  to customize the look and feel of their web experience.
- Implemented custom email templates leveraging MailChimp and Klaviyo allowing the advertising team to create and execute marketing campaigns.
- Supported retainer clients by fixing bugs and adding new features while keeping the codebase performant and maintainable.

positions.title: Instructor Assistant - Remote Code Reviewer
positions.description:
- Work with a team of developers to quickly provide feedback and recommendations on prototypes and projects of current LearningFuze students.
- Assign pull requests, pull code from GitHub, and debug any issues with the student's code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, AJAX, and AngularJS).
- Offer students helpful resources to help them gain a better understanding of key concepts.
- Submit tracker forms containing assignment details.  This allows lead instructors to monitor the progress of the students and make the necessary adjustments to improve the learning experience.
